title: TESLA INSIDER: Elon Musk Deleted All Defaults at Tesla & SpaceX
summary: Curated YouTube transcript reviewed as untrusted lead material. It presents promotional and anecdotal commentary about Musk-company engineering, manufacturing, hiring, cost, speed, and organizational practices. Existing registered Tesla primary evidence supports only the maintained Q2 operating, capital-intensity, autonomy, robotics, and execution-risk context; no video-only claim changed a maintained conclusion or paper-trading state.
